description: Absolutely stunning, extensively remodeled townhome located on a quiet, tree-lined street in the heart of the North Hollywood Arts District. This front-facing residence is the largest unit in the complex and offering 3 bedrooms, with 2.5 bathrooms and approximately 1,318 square feet of beautifully designed living space. The light-filled interior features a modern aesthetic with crisp white walls, bold black accents, and an open layout enhanced by sliding glass doors that bring in abundant natural light throughout the day. The updated kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and ample cabinetry, while energy-efficient central heating and air with a smart NEST thermostat adds comfort and efficiency. Enjoy two private balconies, one downstairs with storage, facing the tree-lined street, and another upstairs, perfect for morning coffee, relaxing evenings, or entertaining. The primary bathroom features custom tile work with a shower/tub combination, and the home includes in-unit laundry with Washer & dryerUpstairs and another hook up located on the main level. The gated community offers resort-style amenities including a pool and spa, security entrance, recreation room, laundry room, subterranean covered parking, private storage areas, a separate bike room, and two side-by-side assigned parking spaces. An electric vehicle charging hookup is already installed next to the parking space, and ample street parking is available for guests. Ideally situated near top restaurants, parks, entertainment, studios, shopping, public transportation, and with easy access to the 101, 134 , and 170 freeways, this home delivers the perfect blend of tranquility and urban convenience. Priced to sell! don’t miss this exceptional opportunity in one of Los Angeles’ most desirable neighborhoods.
